summary: Create an inventory: Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Inventories > Create inventory, pick the type, and set Name, Organization (required), Smart host filter for smart inventories (e.g. name__icontains=RedHat, case-sensitive) and Instance groups in run order.
questions: How do I create an inventory in AAP 2.6?
How do I set a smart host filter?
Can I assign instance groups to an inventory?
Is the smart host filter case sensitive?
